name: learned_kernels_v1
label: Learned-kernel extension on PRH released-code representations (COCO)
evaluation_status_reason: COCO val2017 leftover after 2048/1024/1024 is 904 images; a duplicate-disjoint confirmatory gallery of 1024 is unavailable. Evaluation uses the existing PRH test split (n=1024), which was inspected during the baseline audit.
panel: all 18 vision-language pairs from the extracted 6 LM x 3 ViT panel

feature_prep.clip_quantile_scope: per split, from the feature tensor being prepared (PRH gallery-level, not a train-frozen threshold)
feature_prep.pooling: unchanged from caches (vision CLS, language mask-mean)
new_train_only_quantities: layer pair via max train linear CKA

layer_selection.metric: extension linear CKA (centred Gram Frobenius, no +1e-6)
layer_selection.rule: max over all stored PRH candidate layers; freeze for all kernels and objectives
layer_selection.tie_break: smaller language layer index, then smaller vision layer index
layer_selection.prh_eval_maxima: results/prh_released_code pair_table remains a separate reference; not the comparator for held-out kernel gains

kernels.standardised_distance: r = ||x-x'|| / s with s = train median off-diagonal Euclidean distance after PRH prep on the frozen layer of that model. Shared dimensionless (lambda, alpha) do not imply identical raw bandwidths.
kernels.rq: k = (1 + ||x-x'||^2 / (2 alpha lambda^2 s^2))^(-alpha); lambda and alpha shared across sides
kernels.boundary: lambda in {0.1, 10} or alpha in {0.1, 100} reported as boundary optima; grid not expanded from eval

estimator.name: extension_centred_gram_cka
estimator.centering: O(n^2) row/col mean form, algebraically HKH
estimator.official_eps: platonic-rep / our linear_cka and rbf_cka add 1e-6 to the CKA denominator; preserved for replication scores, not used in a/b algebra
estimator.reject: non-finite; ||Kc||_F or ||Lc||_F <= 1e-12 * ||K||_F (constant after centering); ratio undefined if |tr(Kc)tr(Lc)| <= 1e-12 * n * ||Kc||_F * ||Lc||_F

selection.tie_break: higher objective, then smaller lambda, then smaller alpha, then family rbf before rq is N/A (families selected separately)

stability.sampling: deterministic permutation of train indices with generator seed 7; contiguous chunks 0:682, 682:1364, 1364:2046; leftover 2 unused

profile_measure.quadrature: closed trapezoid on 513 equally spaced nodes

shuffle_fit_control.note: Monte Carlo resolution is 2 repeats x 3 pairs. Not a CI. Distinct from fixed-kernel eval permutations.

u_centred_diagnostic: Song et al. 2012 unbiased HSIC CKA already in metrics.hsic_unbiased; not used as a fitting objective; negatives retained; zero denominator flagged
